UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document containing student identity details.

photoURL.description: External auth photo URL if present.

avatarRemoved.description: Whether the user explicitly removed their profile picture.

academicLevel.description: Academic level e.g. Undergraduate Senior, High School.

careerInterest.description: Student's career interest or target domain.

targetExam.description: Target exam name or learning milestone.

upcomingExams.description: Additional upcoming exams and target dates.

learningGoal.description: User-defined learning goal when preparing for a goal or milestone.

subjects.description: List of subjects or skills the student is studying.

weakTopics.description: Topics flagged by the student as needing extra revision.

timetable.description: Optional existing college or work timetable constraints.

preferredStudyDays.description: Preferred days of the week for scheduled study.

secondaryEducation.description: Self-reported Class 10 board, school, passing year, marks, and percentage.

higherSecondaryEducation.description: Self-reported Class 12 or equivalent board, school, stream, passing year, marks, and percentage.

semesterResults.description: Self-reported undergraduate semester SGPA, CGPA, credits, and year records.

goals.description: User-created personal, academic, and skill goals and milestones.

experiences.description: Internship, research, work, and leadership records.

socialLinks.description: GitHub, LinkedIn, and personal portfolio URLs.

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether the student has completed initial study profile onboarding.

onboardingStep.description: Last saved step index for partial onboarding recovery.

dailyGoalHours.description: Target study goal in hours per day.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update.

ProfileAvatar.title: ProfileAvatar
ProfileAvatar.description: Private owner-only compressed profile picture data stored separately from the main user document.

dataUrl.description: Validated and resized JPEG/PNG/WebP data URL.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: User preferences and study configuration stored in subcollection settings/preferences.

preferredStudyDays.description: Comma-separated or formatted list of preferred study days.

defaultStudyDurationMinutes.description: Default study session duration in minutes.

interfaceLanguage.description: Interface language (e.g. en, es, fr, de).

studyRemindersEnabled.description: Whether daily study notification reminders are enabled.

examRemindersEnabled.description: Whether upcoming exam countdown reminders are enabled.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last preferences update.

StudyPlan.title: StudyPlan
StudyPlan.description: User-created or reviewed AI study plan stored under users/{userId}/studyPlans/{planId}.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document owned exclusively by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/settings/preferences.description: Preferences document for user appearance, study goals, and reminders.

/users/{userId}/studyPlans/{planId}.description: Saved study plans owned exclusively by the authenticated user.
